user_story: As a user, I want my password reset token to be invalidated after use so that it cannot be reused.

positive.title: Validate password reset token after first use
steps: Use the token to reset the password.
Attempt to use the same token again to reset the password.
positive.expected_result: The system should indicate that the token is invalid for reuse.

negative.title: Attempt to reset password without a token
steps: Attempt to reset the password without providing any token.
negative.expected_result: The system should return an error indicating that a valid token is required.

edge.title: Request multiple password reset tokens
steps: Request a password reset token multiple times in quick succession.
Use the first token to reset the password.
Attempt to use the remaining tokens.
edge.expected_result: Only the used token should be invalid; other tokens should remain valid until used or expired.
